title: Knife Throw Frenzy
description: Sink gleaming throwing knives into spinning wooden targets and boss wheels—thread tight gaps, slice bonus apples, and never hit another blade.
controls: Tap anywhere to fling a knife straight up into the rotating target without colliding with embedded blades.

zh-CN.title: 疯狂甩飞刀
zh-CN.description: 国民级魔性见缝插针甩飞刀：看准旋转木桩的缝隙一键连射飞刀、切爆苹果、干碎强力 Boss 轮盘根本停不下来！
zh-CN.controls: 点击屏幕向上掷出飞刀扎入旋转靶盘，避开已有飞刀插满全部飞刀即可破关。
